turn.content: The contract has no price for this coffee machine. The only addendum (KTR-V-025#11.1) concerns a different item (Air Mineral Galon 19L), not the Mesin Kopi Otomatis. Clause #2.1 says prices are in Lampiran A and fixed; no applicable unit price appears for this item, so the contract doesn't authorize the higher price. The PO price is 6,107,900 and the invoice bills 6,390,200 — a unit price above the PO with no contractual basis.

tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0185", "detail": "Line for 'Mesin Kopi Otomatis' has quantity 1 at unit price 6107900; invoice bills 6390200 per unit."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-025#2.1", "detail": "Unit prices are those in Lampiran A and remain fixed for the agreement term; no contract price for this item authorizes a higher price."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-025#11.1", "detail": "The only price addendum changes Air Mineral Galon 19L to Rp 22.600 from 1 September 2026, a different item from the Mesin Kopi Otomatis."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "INV/2026/09/0580", "detail": "Line 1 unit price 6390200 exceeds the PO unit price 6107900."}], "explanation": "The invoice's unit price of 6390200 is above the PO price of 6107900, and no contract clause or addendum sets a price for this item, so the excess is an unentitled overcharge."}]}
